urlText: L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines weeknight full closures due to maintenance
content:
Monday 12 to Wednesday 14 May
  • Each night from 9pm to 1am, L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines light rail services will not run due to planned trackwork and maintenance works.
  • During this time, use alternative transport including:
    • Replacement bus services or regular bus services between Central Chalmers Street and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford,
    • Train services, regular bus services or walking if able to, between Circular Quay and Central Chalmers Street.
Replacement bus services:
  • Replacement bus services will run every 10 to 15 minutes from 9pm to 1am nightly. These times may vary depending on road traffic.
  • Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations:
    • Surry Hills (towards Central and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford) - Please use the alternative stop at Central Chalmers Street (approx. 8 minute walk),
    • Wansey Road (towards Central) - Please use the alternative stop at Royal Randwick (approx. 12 minute walk),
    • UNSW High Street (towards Central and Randwick) - Please use the alternative stop at Randwick (approx. 10 minute walk).
  • Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service.
  • See the news story for more detailed service information.
  • Allow extra travel time and use Trip Planner to see if your travel is affected.
subtitle: L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines weeknight full closures due to maintenance

urlText: Parramatta bus diversions for A-League game
content:
Road closures will be in place on sections of O’Connell St, Ross St and Victoria Rd on Saturday 10 May for an A-League match at CommBank Stadium.
 
The following bus stops will be closed and routes 546, 549, 550, 600, 601 and 606 will be diverting while the road closures are in place between approximately 9.30pm to 10pm. 
 
Walk to nearby alternative stops, see the road closure and transport map for more details:
  • Parramatta Leagues Club, O'Connell Street will be closed – alternative stop O’Connell Street opp Harold Street (for services towards the Hills and North West)
  • Our Lady of Mercy College, O'Connell Street will be closed – alternative stop O’Connell Street at Fennell Street (for services towards Parramatta Station)
  • Victoria Road after Villiers Street will be closed – alternative stop All Saints Anglican Church, Victoria Road (for services towards Parramatta Station)
  • Victoria Road before Marist Place will be closed – alternative stop O’Connell Street opp Harold Street (for services towards the Hills, Epping and Macquarie Park)
Check signs at stops and see the event page for more info.

urlText: Sydney Olympic Park diversions for a special event
content:
From 1.30am to 1.30pm on Sunday 18 May, Route 525 and Route 526 services will be diverting while roads are closed in Sydney Olympic Park for the Sydney 10 event by Athletics NSW. 
 
Services in both directions will be diverting via Edwin Flack Avenue, Sarah Durack Avenue and Australia Avenue, and will miss stops on Dawn Fraser Avenue and Park Street. Catch these services from the stop on Park Street at Olympic Park train station or other alternative stop locations on Edwin Flack Avenue.
 
Allow extra time and check signs at stops for alternative stop locations.
 
Closed stops:
  • Park Street opposite Olympic Park Station, Sydney Olympic Park (212790)
    Alternative stop: Olympic Park Station, Park Street, Sydney Olympic Park (212712)
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue opposite Olympic Park Station, Sydney Olympic Park (212791)
    Alternative stop: Olympic Park Station, Park Street, Sydney Olympic Park (212712)
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue before Edwin Flack Avenue, Sydney Olympic Park (212788)
    Alternative stop: Edwin Flack Avenue opposite Accor Stadium, Sydney Olympic Park (212735)
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue after Edwin Flack Avenue, Sydney Olympic Park (212787)
    Alternative stop for Route 526 only: Sydney Olympic Park Athletic Centre, Edwin Flack Avenue, Sydney Olympic Park (212733)
    Alternative stop for Route 525 only: Accor Stadium, Edwin Flack Avenue, Sydney Olympic Park (212736)
  • Olympic Park Station, Dawn Fraser Avenue, Sydney Olympic Park (212792)
